certificates.main.title: Gift certificates
certificates.title: "ARBER" gift certificate
certificates.title.paragraph: An original and at the same time practical gift for friends or loved ones. With our certificate, you will no longer have the question "What to give this time". The convenience of such a gift is that you choose the denomination of the certificate, and the recipient decides for himself which product to spend it on. Thus, he will definitely receive the desired and correct gift.
certificates.title.paragraph1: Such a certificate can be given for any event, because everyone loves stylish clothes and will definitely be happy to update their wardrobe. Since ARBER produces clothes for men and women, a gift certificate can be called a universal present.
certificates.title1.paragraph: You can purchase a certificate for an offline store or for an online store.
certificates.title1.paragraph1: The certificate has no expiration date. The certificate is non-exchangeable and non-refundable.
certificates.title2: Certificates are valid only for ARBER products.
